description: Minimal replay payload derived from the preserved 2026-10-01 Daum Trends run (publish-trace.log, 'OG card render failed before publish'). Both original attempts on the DCInside mobile minor-gallery post URL and the single computed desktop pair attempt failed with HTTP 500 and scrap payload code 40002. The strict pair helper maps every mobile /board/<gallery>/<post> URL to the regular-gallery desktop route /board/view, but this post lives in a minor gallery whose live canonical route is /mgallery/board/view, so the computed pair could never render and the publisher failed the whole post closed before any post was published.
error: OG card render failed before publish
